entities.summary: In economics, industrial organization is a field that extends the theory of the firm by analyzing the structure of firms and markets, as well as the boundaries between them. It introduces real-world features that depart from the perfectly competitive model, such as transaction costs, imperfect information, and barriers to entry faced by potential competitors.
